blind.description: A stylized wooden general store shelving unit with three open shelves plus a stocked top ledge. It is filled with miscellaneous goods including tied sacks, clay pots with lids, coils of rope, folded textiles, wooden buckets, wheels of cheese, and a dark metal lantern on top. The wood has a warm brown finish with beveled posts. One cheese wheel on the bottom shelf clips through the wooden panel on the back side.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden top with protruding rectangular corner posts, bearing from left to right: a tied sack, a round reddish lidded pot, a coiled ring of rope, and a square metal lantern.
defects: A yellow cheese wheel on the bottom shelf clips through the rear wooden backboard.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.2 feet tall (roughly chest height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.

notes: Cheese wheel on bottom shelf clips slightly through rear wooden backboard
